name: Chourico (Portuguese Sausage)
instructions: 1. Remove sausage from casing. 2. Sauté with chopped onions and potatoes. 3. Add a splash of vinegar and cook until oil releases.
description: Spiced pork sausages reflecting Daman's deep Portuguese maritime heritage.
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
